board: BTF-LIGHTING WS2812B 16x16 256-pixel flexible LED panel (160x160 mm FPC, 3-pin JST-SM input 5V, DIN, GND)
reason: The 256-LED addressable-led model and a neopixel-based 16x16 helper driver (WS2812B GRB at 800 kbit/s, zig-zag xy mapping, 10% default brightness) passed the part check on ESP32 and Pico. The 5V pin is fed from an external supply (4.5-5.3 V, 15.36 A at full white). The lookup only matched the word WS2812B (neopixel-ring and the 8x8 panel), which are different products, so this is not a duplicate.
